{{Top|leg}}
'''Anti-speeder mines''' were a type of ground-based [[Mine/Legends|mine]]. They had a variable [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] that allowed them to ignore weak [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] fields such as those produced by [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] and [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]]. This made the mines a danger to heavier vehicles such as [[Speeder truck/Legends|speeder trucks]] and [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortanks]].
